answer: Require each agent to lock a small refundable stake in a shared treasury before it can trade, and let that stake grow with honest history. A Sybil farmer would need to fund every fake identity, so cheap mass creation stops paying. Think of the stake as a ledge: one slip costs real value, while good agents climb toward a longer horizon of rewards. Reputation then compounds like a cedar, slow to grow but hard to fake, so the network rewards patience and punishes disposable identities.
